summary: 本轮增量检索发现 2 项新近公开且相关性较高的工作，均在 2026-08-17 首次公开。ViHaTeleop 聚焦低成本视触觉遥操作，用于采集灵巧操作示教并验证触觉反馈对接触关键任务的帮助；H-PAC Hand 聚焦欠驱动灵巧手的控制建模与腱弹性补偿，直接改善手部姿态可重复性。两者都把灵巧手或灵巧操作作为核心贡献，纳入本次更新。
summary_en: This incremental pass found 2 newly public, highly relevant items, both first released on 2026-08-17. ViHaTeleop focuses on low-cost visual-haptic teleoperation for collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations and shows that tactile feedback helps contact-critical tasks; H-PAC Hand focuses on control modeling and tendon-elasticity compensation for an underactuated dexterous hand, directly improving hand pose reproducibility. Both place dexterous hands or dexterous manipulation at the center, so they are included in this update.

items.title: ViHaTeleop: A Low-Cost, Lightweight Visual-Haptic Teleoperation System for Dexterous Manipulation Learning
items.authors_or_org: Fucai Zhu, Yanhou Lai, Paul Maestre, Koichi Hashimoto
items.relevance: 该工作直接面向灵巧操作示教采集与学习，核心是灵巧手遥操作、接触反馈和多模态示教数据采集，不是泛化的普通机械臂操控。
items.relevance_en: This work directly targets demonstration collection and learning for dexterous manipulation. Its core focus is dexterous hand teleoperation, contact feedback, and multimodal demonstration capture rather than generic arm manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: arXiv 首次公开；同时给出低成本、轻量级硬件实现，并报告了真实与仿真中的触觉增益与下游策略训练验证。
items.novelty_signal_en: First public arXiv release; it also provides a low-cost, lightweight hardware implementation and reports tactile gains plus downstream policy-training validation in both real and simulated settings.
items.analysis_zh: 该工作主要提出 ViHaTeleop，一个面向灵巧操作学习的低成本、轻量级视触觉遥操作系统。它要解决的是高质量、接触敏感示教难以在低成本设备上稳定采集的问题。方法上，系统结合了基于 SLAM 的腕部跟踪、基于相机的手部跟踪，以及通过 LRA 提供的逐指振动反馈，并加入照明、鱼眼手摄像头和触觉感知重定向约束等设计；作者还在 Franka + LEAP Hand + 9DTact 上进行了真实与仿真部署。实验上，9 名参与者在 6 个接触关键任务中对比有无触觉条件，结果显示触觉使所有任务成功率提升 2.2 到 15.6 个百分点，且在仿真和真实环境下都显著提升了接触清晰度和抓取信心；作者进一步用收集到的示教训练视觉-触觉策略，发现触觉线索对 peg-in-hole 等接触子任务有帮助。总结来看，它的价值在于把低成本遥操作、触觉反馈与灵巧操作学习打通，但公开信息对更大规模任务覆盖、长期鲁棒性和更广泛硬件泛化仍不充分。
items.analysis_en: This paper introduces ViHaTeleop, a low-cost and lightweight visual-haptic teleoperation system for dexterous manipulation learning. It addresses the difficulty of collecting high-quality, contact-critical demonstrations with affordable hardware. The method combines SLAM-based wrist tracking, camera-based hand tracking, finger-wise vibrotactile feedback via LRA actuators, and several practical design choices such as LED illumination, a fisheye hand camera, and tactile-aware retargeting constraints; the system is deployed on a Franka arm with a LEAP Hand and 9DTact in both simulation and the real world. In experiments, nine participants performed six contact-critical tasks under matched with/without-haptic conditions. Haptics improved success rates on all tasks by 2.2 to 15.6 percentage points, and subjective ratings showed significantly better contact clarity and grasp confidence in both simulated and real settings. The authors also trained visual-tactile policies from the collected demonstrations and reported that tactile cues improved contact-critical subtasks such as peg-in-hole. Overall, the work is a practical contribution to data collection for dexterous manipulation, but the public information is still limited regarding larger-scale task diversity, long-horizon robustness, and broader hardware generalization.

items.title: H-PAC Hand: Control-Oriented Modeling and Tendon-Elasticity Compensation for an Underactuated Robotic Hand
items.authors_or_org: Teng Yan, Jiongxu Chen, Teng Wang, Yue Yu, Qixiang Hua, Zihang Wang, Yongru Chen, Bingzhuo Zhong
items.relevance: 该工作以欠驱动灵巧手本体、腱传动建模和姿态补偿为核心，直接服务于灵巧机器人手的可控性与重复性。
items.relevance_en: This work centers on the underactuated dexterous hand itself, tendon-driven modeling, and pose compensation, directly improving controllability and repeatability of a robotic hand.
items.novelty_signal: arXiv 首次公开；明确给出手部机构设计、控制建模与补偿模型，并报告了关节角预测误差的显著下降。
items.novelty_signal_en: First public arXiv release; it clearly specifies the hand mechanism, control model, and compensation model, and reports a substantial reduction in joint-angle prediction error.
items.analysis_zh: 该工作主要提出 H-PAC Hand，一种 6 执行器、15 自由度的欠驱动腱驱动机器人手，并配套控制导向建模与腱弹性补偿框架。它要解决的是腱延展和弹簧负载导致的关节偏差、姿态不可重复问题。方法上，作者从腱路由几何出发建立稀疏的解析执行器-关节模型，再用力学补偿模型修正腱弹性引起的误差；系统采用主机端姿态映射与补偿、ESP32 同步控制舵机的分层架构，并且在不同任务中不需要重新调参。实验上，单调舵机扫描显示补偿显著提高关节角预测，食指 DIP 关节 MAE 从 1.15 度降至 0.18 度，9 个评估关节的 MAE 都低于 0.23 度；作者还展示了若干姿态和抓取构型的执行。总结而言，它提供了一条面向紧凑欠驱动灵巧手的实用建模与补偿路线，但公开材料对更复杂操作任务、闭环力反馈以及长期耐久性的覆盖仍然有限。
items.analysis_en: This paper presents H-PAC Hand, a modular 6-actuator, 15-DoF underactuated tendon-driven robotic hand together with a control-oriented modeling and tendon-elasticity compensation framework. It targets the problem that tendon elongation under restoring-spring loading causes configuration-dependent joint deviations and poor pose repeatability. The method derives a sparse analytical actuator-joint model from tendon-routing geometry and adds a mechanics-based compensation model to correct tendon-elasticity-induced errors; the system is implemented in a hierarchical architecture where a host computer handles workspace-constrained posture mapping and compensation while an ESP32 generates synchronized commands for six position-controlled servos. In the experiments, monotonic servo-sweep tests show substantial improvement in joint-angle prediction, with the index DIP joint MAE reduced from 1.15 degrees to 0.18 degrees and all nine evaluated joints below 0.23 degrees MAE. The authors also execute representative postures and grasp configurations with the same control pipeline and without external joint or force sensing in the loop. Overall, the work is a practical step toward more reproducible compact dexterous end-effectors, but the public information is still insufficient on more complex manipulation tasks, closed-loop force control, and long-term durability.
